It is arguably the first major IT services company to systematically reshape roles around AI adoption.

stories.title: Central government employees wait for 8th Pay Commission
stories.summary: Central government employees may wait until 2027 for revised salaries and pensions. The 8th Pay Commission is reviewing benefits for staff and defence personnel, with 18 months allowed for its report. The commission reached its first year on 3 November, but the final step remains pending.

stories.title: Central government employees see DA rise to 63 percent
stories.summary: The Union government increased dearness allowance for central government employees from 60 percent to 63 percent, effective 1 July 2026. A Level 5 employee in an X-class city can now receive a gross monthly salary of 62,224 rupees. The Finance Ministry confirmed the revision on 29 October.

stories.title: Bihar state employees receive dearness allowance hike
stories.summary: The Bihar government approved a dearness allowance increase for state employees and pensioners from 60 percent to 63 percent, effective 1 July 2026. Those under the 5th Pay Commission structure will see rates rise to 497 percent. The decision follows a cabinet meeting ahead of Chhath Puja.

stories.title: Checking if employer contributions reach EPF accounts
stories.summary: Employees are advised to verify that provident fund deductions are actually deposited into their EPF accounts. Companies must contribute 12 percent of basic salary and dearness allowance within 15 days of the month's end. A salary slip deduction does not guarantee the money has reached the retirement fund.

stories.title: EPFO offers reduced penalties for delayed PF deposits
stories.summary: The EPFO has launched the VISHWAS 2026 scheme to settle pending provident fund damage disputes at reduced rates. Employers must apply by 28 December to resolve defaults occurring before 14 June 2024. The scheme offers a limited window to avoid prolonged litigation over delayed remittances.

stories.title: EPFO highlights online correction process for account details
stories.summary: Incorrect personal details in EPF accounts can delay withdrawals and claim settlements. The EPFO has highlighted its online Joint Declaration facility to help members fix name, gender, or date of birth mismatches. The organisation claims the process takes five steps to ensure records are accurate.

stories.title: Tax rules for Bhai Dooj cash gifts between siblings
stories.summary: Under the Income-tax Act 2025, money received from a brother or sister is exempt from income tax regardless of the amount. While a 5 lakh rupee transfer for Bhai Dooj may appear significant, the law provides an exemption for genuine gifts exchanged between specified relatives.

stories.title: Tax implications for Bhai Dooj gifts
stories.summary: Gifts received by a sister from a sibling are exempt from income tax under Section 56 of the Income-tax Act, 1961. This applies to cash, jewellery, and other valuables exchanged during the festival. The tax exemption remains regardless of the total value of the items gifted.

stories.title: Gifting gold ETFs for Bhai Dooj
stories.summary: Investors can gift gold ETF units as an alternative to physical jewellery for Bhai Dooj. Unlike mutual funds, these assets trade on stock exchanges with real-time price fluctuations. The process requires a demat account, and experts suggest it as a way to help siblings build investment portfolios.

stories.title: Supreme Court rules on grandson property claims
stories.summary: The Supreme Court ruled that a grandson cannot claim a share by birth in property inherited by his father after a partition. Once property devolves to a Class I heir, it becomes his exclusive estate. The ruling clarifies the distinction between individual and joint family property.

research.title: Advancing AI Capabilities and Evolving Labor Outcomes
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: This paper examines how labor market outcomes have evolved across occupations as AI capabilities advanced from generative AI chatbots to reasoning models and AI agents. We construct an occupational AI exposure score that measures the share. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Anchors in the Machine: Behavioral and Attributional Evidence of Anchoring Bias in LLMs
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly studied as behavioral subjects (e.g., synthetic participants or users) and decision systems (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge), yet it remains unclear how observed cognitive biases relate to changes in model output probabilities. Anchoring. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Does fare communication format matter? Evidence from a randomised experiment in public transport
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Highly concentrated demand in public transport places pressure on infrastructure and reduces service quality. Pricing instruments-such as discounted off-peak single fare tickets-are a widely used tool for rescheduling demand across time. Yet no study has directly. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Equilibrium Selection in Coordination Games with Planned Actions and Scouting
research.summary: Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study Stag Hunt games in which every action requires planning and preparation. Before players act, they observe noisy signals of their opponent's preparations and can revise their plans, which allows players to screen for cooperation. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Ever since Ellsberg
research.summary: Announce Type: replace Abstract: Ellsberg's famous paradox challenged Savage's subjective expected utility theory (EUT) -- which reduces uncertainty to risk -- by suggesting an aversion toward ambiguity. We provide a revealed preference test of the full set of axioms underpinning. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Fairness Drift: Assessing Algorithmic Fairness in a Moving Market
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Flexible models and richer data can reduce systematic valuation errors and improve fairness. Yet algorithmic values stay fixed between updates while the market moves, so a new algorithm gains most against an intact distortion and least. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Fiscal Commitment and the Additionality of Philanthropy: Heterogeneous Donor Purposes in a Shared Public Budget
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Philanthropic donors often value different public services, while a budget authority allocates public spending across a shared portfolio. Policy frameworks frequently seek to ensure that private finance supplements rather than displaces public funding. We distinguish baseline. Preprint, not peer reviewed.

research.title: Fueling Inflation Risks: An Oil Shortage Scenario
research.summary: Announce Type: new Abstract: Central banks routinely use alternative scenarios to assess risks to the economic outlook, but these are usually generated from linear models that are unable to speak to the likelihood of extreme outcomes. We develop a nonlinear. Preprint, not peer reviewed.
